sources: https://blainecounty-mt.gov/ (home page, links 'Zurich Park Fee Schedule 2023')

values.note: Blaine County's fee schedule (dated January 1, 2023, still the one linked from the county home page): '$30.00 HOOKUP FEE PER DAY (UNLESS HALL IS RENTED ...)'. Free dry camping comes only from aggregator reviews; the county does not state it.

fees.source: https://blainecounty-mt.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Zurich-Park-Fee-Schedule-2023.pdf ('$30.00 HOOKUP FEE PER DAY'; 'DATED THIS 1st DAY OF JANUARY 2023'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The county lists '12 Electric Hookups' without an amperage; the 50-amp figure came only from Campendium reviews (6 newer 50-amp, 5 older 30-amp).

season.source: https://blainecounty-mt.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Zurich-Park-Fee-Schedule-2023.pdf (no season stated; the derived 'seasonal' came only from aggregator listings), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://blainecounty-mt.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Zurich-Park-Fee-Schedule-2023.pdf (rules cover hall rentals only; nothing on reserving campsites; the derived FCFS came only from aggregator listings), read 2026-10-22

summary: Blaine County's only page for the park is its 2023 fee schedule: confirmed $30/day hookup fee (dated 2023) and drinking-water spigots, 12 electric hookups. Cleared derived values that rest only on aggregators (Campendium/RV Life) and the county does not state: 50-amp electric, $0 low (free dry camping), vault toilets, seasonal, not reservable/FCFS. Note kept (aggregator-sourced description, not contradicted).
flags: Missing website: the county's own page is https://blainecounty-mt.gov/ (fee schedule PDF https://blainecounty-mt.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Zurich-Park-Fee-Schedule-2023.pdf); the park has no page of its own. Town/county park, so it stays (curation: town and county parks exempt from the removal half).

Phone: 406-357-4261 does not appear on any county page; the fee schedule is issued by the County Commissioners, whose number is (406) 357-3240 (https://blainecounty-mt.gov/directory/), the number the aggregators give for the park.

Fee date: the county's fee schedule is dated 2023-01-01, older than the 2024 rate rule; recorded as $30 high with checked 2023 because it is still the posted schedule. Not stated: whether non-hookup (dry) camping is allowed or free.
